text: The following question stood in the name of  Mr Xie Yao Quan –   15 To ask the Minister for Manpower (a) whether there has been a rise in salary disputes between workers who self-isolate without medical certificates under COVID-19 Protocol 2 and their employers; (b) how many low-wage workers have been affected as such; and (c) what are the Ministry’s plans to assist affected workers.

speaker: Mr Deputy Speaker
text: Would a Member like to rise to ask it in his stead?
